goal: Prioritise vulnerabilities by risk using Kenna Security exports: threat intelligence, exposure and asset valu…
use: Prioritise vulnerabilities by risk using Kenna Security exports: threat intelligence, exposure and asset value. Use when a Kenna export needs risk-based priorities.

steps.note: Read the export. Use the vulnerability export the user provides from Kenna Security.
Check the risk inputs. Note which inputs are present: threat intelligence, exploit availability, asset criticality and exposure.
Rank by risk. Put first the findings with known exploits on exposed, critical assets.
Check the scope. Confirm the assets and scans in the export are the ones the team owns.
Compare with the code. Where a finding points at code, check the code path before advising a fix.
Report. A ranked list: risk, finding, asset, exploit status, exposure, and the recommended action.

protocol.title: Read the export
protocol.text: Use the vulnerability export the user provides from Kenna Security. Do not connect to the platform without the user's own access.

protocol.title: Check the risk inputs
protocol.text: Note which inputs are present: threat intelligence, exploit availability, asset criticality and exposure. Flag missing inputs, because they weaken the ranking.

protocol.title: Rank by risk
protocol.text: Put first the findings with known exploits on exposed, critical assets. Keep severity as one input, not the only one.

protocol.title: Check the scope
protocol.text: Confirm the assets and scans in the export are the ones the team owns. Flag stale scans.

protocol.title: Compare with the code
protocol.text: Where a finding points at code, check the code path before advising a fix.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: A ranked list: risk, finding, asset, exploit status, exposure, and the recommended action. State which inputs were missing, and that the ranking is advice to a person to confirm. Mark what you could not verify.
